newsitem.title: UK: BAe confirms prime role in Qatar defence deal.
newsitem.headline: BAe confirms prime role in Qatar defence deal.

text.p: British Aerospace Plc confirmed on Monday that it would take the prime contractor role in a 500 million stg inter-government defence equipment package sealed between Britain and Qatar at the weekend.

"We are delighted to be leading this British industrial consortium and look forward to close cooperation with Qatar and its defence forces," BAe chairman Sir Richard Evans said in a company statement.

The other participants in the consortium include GKN Plc, which will sell an unspecified number of Piranha armoured cars, Shorts supplying Starburst missiles and Vosper Thornycroft which will sell patrol vessels. "This is excellent news for British Aerospace, with the order for Hawk training aircraft following close on the selection of Hawk by the Australian Defence Force," Evans added.

British Aerospace shares, which had slipped quite sharply earlier on Monday after weekend news that BAe's consortium had been deselected from an early round of U.S. tenders for the Joint Strike Fighter, trimmed their losses during the day as details of the Qatar deal emerged. By 1430 GMT the shares were down 5p at 1138-1/2p, well off an earlier low of 1128p.
